rows.grounds: epithet or part of place name

items.question: Which sacred lake is located seventeen bow-lengths beyond the previously mentioned site?
premises: A distance of seventeen bow-lengths is specified.
The location reached at that distance is named Ūrdhvāśārāsaka.
The site identified is a lake called Vāsaka.
items.inference: At a distance of seventeen bow-lengths lies the Ūrdhvāśārāsaka Vāsaka lake.
uncertainties: Whether vāsaka functions as an epithet or as an integral part of the lake's proper name is unclear.
items.plain_english: Seventeen bow-lengths further on is the Ūrdhvāśārāsaka Vāsaka lake.
